entries.claimSummaryRu: Общие лимиты скорости CABA для calles, avenidas, pasajes/calles de convivencia, быстрых arterias и специальных участков.
entries.notes: Used only for compact CABA speed-grid claims needed by assigned tickets; ticket-specific image exceptions remain explained at ticket level.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Национальные лимиты для rutas, semiautopistas и rutas through urban zones used by the assigned speed-limit tickets.
entries.notes: No Decreto 779 annex-specific sign claim is made in this topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Velocidad precautoria depends on driver, vehicle, visibility, road, weather and traffic conditions, not only the posted maximum.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.2.1 Adecuación de la velocidad a las circunstancias
entries.notes: Supports the weather and paso-a-nivel learning material without generalizing beyond assigned ticket needs.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA requires low beams twenty-four hours on all autopistas, Av. Gral. Paz, Av. Leopoldo Lugones and Av. Intendente Cantilo.
entries.notes: Included because b-fallback-250 is assigned to speed-limits through the current road-context taxonomy.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Drivers must warn non-predictable or directional maneuvers in advance using the corresponding lights and may/should reinforce with manual signals when needed.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
entries.notes: Supports only the general warning/manual-signal rule. The exact fallback image-to-answer mapping for giro derecha, detenerse, and giro izquierda remains ticket-specific because the current archive does not contain a separate official illustrated hand-signal catalogue.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Emergency/intermittent lights and balizas warn stopped vehicles, egresos, risky or unusual maneuvers, obstructions and force-majeure incidents; they do not replace safe conduct.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.5.3 Comportamiento general en caso de averías o imprevistos
Ley 2148 6.3.1 Generalidades, luces intermitentes de emergencia o balizas
Ley 24.449 Artículo 47 Uso de las luces
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-002 emergency/balizas context and b-fallback-263 warning/safety framing without generalizing the unsupported fallback choice to every autopista incident scenario.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA road-context definitions for via publica, calle/avenida/autopista/semiautopista and listed vias rapidas used by Cantilo, Lugones and General Paz tickets.
relevantSections: Definiciones: Arteria, Banquina, Semiautopista, Via publica, Via Rapida
entries.notes: Used for compact road-context prose and CABA fast-road examples already present in assigned tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Banquina is adjacent and parallel to the carriageway on routes/highways/semihighways/caminos and exists for traffic safety, not as an ordinary travel lane.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-197 explanation without adding unrelated shoulder-use scenarios.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Ley 24.449 semihighway/highway context, including semiautopista definition and exit/deceleration-lane rule for highways with semihighway applicability.
entries.notes: Supports autopista/semiautopista route context and b-fallback-315. Does not cite Decreto 779 annex signage claims.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Road type affects speed-limit and low-beam answers in assigned tickets: urban streets/avenues/routes/semihighways have different speed rules, and CABA requires low beams on fast roads named in the tickets.
entries.notes: Reuses existing archived laws for road-type-linked speed and low-beam claims. Route-sign recognition remains ticket-specific without annex/manual claims.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines a uniform traffic-sign system that communicates orders, warnings, indications and orientations; regulatory/prescriptive signs transmit mandatory specific orders.
entries.notes: Supports compact topic prose distinguishing reglamentarias from preventivas and informativas.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned ticket meanings for PARE, velocidad mínima, giro obligatorio, carril exclusivo, tránsito pesado a la derecha and contramano.
relevantSections: R.23 Tránsito pesado a la derecha
entries.notes: Used only for sign meanings present in the assigned E3 tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L distinguishes warning/preventive signs, informative signs and transitory signs, including examples used as classification traps in the assigned tickets.
relevantSections: Información turística y de servicios: Aeropuerto, Plaza
entries.notes: Supports trap notes for tickets whose correct answer is warning, informative or transitory rather than regulatory.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Current law/code provisions support ticket-specific statements that some dangerous-place answers are prohibited by normativa rather than by needing a separate visible sign.
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-207, b-fallback-211, b-fallback-331 and b-fallback-411 explanations without expanding the topic into a full overtaking or parking lesson.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines the uniform road-sign system and supports the role of warning/preventive signs, including the importance of shape and color for sign categories.
entries.notes: Used for compact warning-sign prose and the ticket b-fallback-306 color/form explanation.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned ticket meanings for preventive/warning signs such as curves, winding road, slopes, narrowing, divided road, roundabout, lateral traffic incorporation, double circulation, schoolchildren, pedestrians and roadworks proximity.
relevantSections: P.20 Principio y fin de calzada dividida
Capítulo VIII Señalamiento transitorio / zona de obras
entries.notes: Supports only meanings present in assigned E4 tickets; route/information/regulatory topics remain outside this slice.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Traffic authority indications prevail over road signs, and signs prevail over general legal norms for the operational hierarchy tested by assigned tickets.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 2.3.4 Prioridades / orden de prioridad normativo
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-311, b-fallback-347 and b-fallback-444 explanations without broadening this slice into a full authority/signaling topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA priority rules support the incorporation-ticket distinction: a vehicle incorporating into an arteria must not interfere with circulating traffic, while vehicles already stopped/interrupted on that arteria must yield to the incorporating vehicle.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
Ley 2148 6.7.2 Otras prioridades de paso, inciso c)
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-389 and b-fallback-440 incorporation-priority explanations; it does not turn warning-sign recognition into a full right-of-way topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Operational authority/control orders and transitory signaling may prevail over traffic lights; traffic lights replace ordinary unsignalized-intersection priority rules.
relevantSections: Anexo L Capítulo I punto 1 Concepto
entries.notes: Supports the compact hierarchy and transitory-signal-over-semaphore explanations for assigned tickets without adding broader traffic-control doctrine.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Traffic light colors and flashing lights define vehicle actions; left turns on signalized two-way intersections require a specific light signal.
relevantSections: Anexo L punto 32 Significado de las luces
entries.notes: Used for red/yellow flashing signal traps and left-turn tickets b-fallback-191, b-fallback-340 and b-fallback-403.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Drivers must cross level crossings only after checking there is no train and no risk; barriers, red railway signals and rail proximity impose stopping/clearance duties.
relevantSections: Anexo L punto 36.c Semáforos especiales para cruce ferrovial con barreras
entries.notes: Supports assigned rail-crossing ticket explanations and the compact 5 m / 20 km/h / stop-before-barrier logic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: At unsignalized CABA intersections, artery hierarchy and right-side priority apply with specific exceptions, including vehicles leaving a level crossing; speed limits differ for streets and avenues.
entries.notes: Used only for assigned no-traffic-light right-of-way and precautionary-speed tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L sign entries support the assigned sign meanings for railway crossing, more than two tracks, railway barriers, curve prevention panels and movable bridges.
relevantSections: Anexo L P.1 Cruce ferrovial a nivel
Anexo L P.2 Paneles de prevención
Anexo L P.3 Cruz de San Andrés
Anexo L P.24-1 Encrucijada con paso a nivel en giro
entries.notes: Supports only the sign-recognition tickets physically assigned to this topic; broader sign taxonomy remains in other slices.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Emergency-service-like vehicles must warn with lights/horn/cloth or equivalent means; other drivers must yield, and overtaking requires checking signals, oncoming traffic and other overtaking maneuvers.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.5.2 Otros vehículos en servicio de emergencia
Ley 2148 6.5.3 Comportamiento de otros conductores respecto de los vehículos de emergencia
entries.notes: Used for b-fallback-093, b-fallback-134, b-fallback-139 and b-fallback-407 explanations without broadening the slice into a full emergency or passing topic.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Required circulation documents and vehicle identification include valid license, cédula, insurance, VTV, and regulatory plates.
entries.notes: Used for general document checklist and plate-placement claims; current cédula azul authorization is traced separately because DNRPA/ANSV changed that practice.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Current cédula guidance: cédula azul is no longer an exigible circulation document; third-party use can be supported by physical delivery/possession of Cédula de Identificación and/or Mi Argentina/Cédula Digital authorization.
relevantSections: La cédula azul ya no es documento exigible para la circulación de vehículos en el país
Ley 2148 5.2.2 Obligación de exhibir documentos / 5.2.3 Cédula de identificación del automotor
Disposición 29/2024: physical delivery of Cédula de Identificación as authorization exteriorization
entries.notes: Used to keep generalized prose current and to mark b-fallback-024, b-fallback-309, and b-fallback-456 as legacy/stale cédula wording where needed.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Current CABA first VTV rule for private cars/motorcycles: fourth year or 64,000 km, with Ley 6631 legal wording of 60,000 km plus 4,000 km tolerance.
relevantSections: Nuevas medidas en el trámite de la VTV: Primera Verificación
entries.notes: Used for current VTV prose and to explain b-fallback-135 as a stale old-ticket conflict rather than current law.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA VTV schedule is by final license-plate digit and failed/conditional results allow 60 business days for free re-verification.
relevantSections: Para aplicar la exención de pago a la hora de realizar la VTV
Resultados de la VTV: Resultados habituales
Artículo 20.- Plazos y vigencia de los certificados
entries.notes: Supports VTV final-digit month explanations for b-fallback-114, b-fallback-214, b-fallback-259 and the 60 días hábiles explanation for b-fallback-072.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA license expiration has no general grace period except non-business-day transfer; renewal as renewal requires no more than one year since expiration.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-218 and b-fallback-395.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA authority may retain licenses only in listed cases; alcohol-positive control prevents continued driving and orders vehicle removal.
relevantSections: 5.4.7 Procedimiento para casos de control de alcoholemia positivo
entries.notes: Supports retención explanations for b-fallback-092, b-fallback-157, b-fallback-322 and the document-personal trap.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Mandatory insurance covers third parties transported or not, and crash participants must stop, assist/collaborate, and provide license/insurance/vehicle data.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.5.1 Obligaciones en caso de incidentes viales
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-173, b-fallback-253, and b-fallback-432; emergency-call details in b-fallback-062 remain ticket-specific wording.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA SEPC/Scoring assigns 20 initial points and deducts points for confirmed infractions.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-243 and b-fallback-367.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Driver control duties include keeping physical control/attention, seat-belt use, precautionary speed, prudent following distance, and authorized towing/removal rules.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.3 Cinturón de seguridad. Obligación de uso
Ley 2148 6.2.1 Adecuación de la velocidad a las circunstancias. Velocidad precautoria
Ley 2148 5.5.3 Comportamiento general en caso de averías o imprevistos
Ley 2148 6.1.9 Autopistas y otras vías rápidas
entries.notes: Supports risk-control ticket explanations for b-fallback-137, b-fallback-208, b-fallback-290, b-fallback-300, and b-fallback-451 without broadening the topic into vehicle-safety prose.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Duplicate/replacement chapa patente is processed before the Registro where the vehicle is registered, with provisional paper plates until definitive duplicates are delivered.
relevantSections: Obtener un duplicado de la chapa patente del automotor
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-226 and plate-document trap notes.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Basic road-system principles include safe use of public roads, preserving fluidez, not obstructing circulation, and avoiding danger, harm or unnecessary disturbance.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.1.1 Usuarios de la vía pública
entries.notes: Supports the compact fluidez/seguridad and no-entorpecer generalizations for b-fallback-048 and b-fallback-332.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Drivers must verify safe conditions, keep effective control, permanent attention and prevention, and avoid conduct or impairments that reduce aptitude to drive.
entries.notes: Supports preventive-driving, attention, phone/headset and risky-action explanations; OMS/statistical wording remains ticket-specific and is not generalized.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Archived official sources support minimum vehicle safety systems, seat belts/head restraints, VTV safety/emissions checks, required circulation safety items, legal tire condition, and lighting rules.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 4.1.5 Sistema de iluminación en automotores
Ley 2148 6.1.3 Cinturón de seguridad. Obligación de uso
Ley 2148 6.1.4 Cabezal de seguridad. Uso correcto
Ley 24449 Artículo 47 Uso de las luces
Nuevas medidas en el trámite de la VTV: Primera Verificación
Artículo 20.- Plazos y vigencia de los certificados
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-054, 071, 143, 182, 241, 242, 299, 305 and 393 at the general safety-system level. The 1.6 mm tire threshold in b-fallback-299 is kept as fallback-ticket-specific wording because the current archived documents support legal tire-depth condition but not the numeric threshold.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA archived law supports child front-seat prohibition under 12, two-year beginner-driver condition, vehicle towing/removal/retention in listed cases, and local plus national traffic-law application in CABA.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-109, 113, 145 and 419 without adding new disability-parking privileges beyond the assigned ticket wording.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Archived CABA/Anexo L material supports cyclist-exclusive lanes/sendas and automotor priority duties when crossing them; two-wheel visibility-risk wording is kept to the fallback ticket.
relevantSections: Anexo L H.6 Senda para ciclistas
entries.notes: Supports the cyclist-space explanation for b-fallback-020. The visibility claim for b-fallback-277 is not expanded beyond ticket wording because no archived official source for that road-safety statistic was added in this slice.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA distinguishes detención from estacionamiento, including the ordinary two-minute detención threshold and driver-presence condition used by the assigned stopping/parking tickets.
entries.notes: Used for concise learner-facing distinction between detenerse and estacionar; does not broaden exceptions beyond assigned tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA parking/detention restrictions relevant to double row, sidewalks, fast roads, bus/taxi stops, corners, pedestrian crossings, stop lines, tunnels, bridges and ciclovías.
entries.notes: Supports parking/detention trap notes and image-ticket explanations for double fila and places where both stopping and parking are prohibited.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Balizas/intermittent lights signal stopped vehicles, garage/private-place exits, upcoming stopping/parking or risky maneuvers, breakdowns and emergency/imprevisto situations, but they do not override stopping prohibitions.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
Ley 2148 6.3.1 Generalidades, luces intermitentes de emergencia o balizas
Ley 2148 5.5.3 Comportamiento general en caso de averías o imprevistos
Ley 24.449 Artículo 47 Uso de las luces
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-077, 192, 232, 378, 413 and 442 without claiming balizas authorize otherwise prohibited double-row or no-stopping situations.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Participants in an incident must stop immediately; drivers must allow emergency vehicles to pass; traffic agents and road-work personnel indications can require drivers to stop in controlled situations.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 5.5.1 Obligaciones en caso de incidentes viales
Ley 2148 6.5.3 Comportamiento de otros conductores respecto de los vehículos de emergencia
Ley 2148 6.1.16 Circulación en tramos de arterias con estrechamientos temporarios
entries.notes: Used for incident, emergency vehicle, traffic-agent and work-zone stopping tickets; personal de obra wording is scoped to road-work controlled passage in the assigned ticket.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L meanings for No estacionar, No estacionar ni detenerse, PARE, Corredor aéreo, Estacionamiento, Aeropuerto and Plaza used by assigned image-ticket explanations.
entries.notes: The theater image answer remains ticket-specific fallback wording because the archived Anexo L entry did not expose a TEATRO section in text search.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines informative signs as signs that identify, orient and reference services, places or other useful information without themselves transmitting orders or warning of road risks unless they contain regulatory or warning signs.
entries.notes: Supports only the general information-sign category prose for E9. The b-fallback-274 pedestrian-oriented sign classification remains ticket-specific because local text search did not expose an exact Anexo L pedestrian information-sign entry.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L service/tourism information entries support the assigned meanings for puesto sanitario, gomería and estacionamiento, and distinguish gomería from servicio mecánico and estación de servicio.
relevantSections: Capítulo V punto 24 Información turística y de servicios
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-066, b-fallback-287 and b-fallback-455. This slice did not generalize theater/cultural-venue signs because that gap is already tracked for future refinement.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA parking-clearance rules relevant to health-center entrances, time-qualified school/temple/bank entrances, rail crossings, corners/ochava, pedestrian crossings/stop lines, vehicle entrances and ordinary 20 cm parallel parking from the curb.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-028, 121, 249 and 412. The hospital/health-center 10 m ticket logic is unconditional for those health entrances; school, temple and bank entrance examples are time-qualified by Ley 2148 7.1.9(l). The 20 m and 5 m distractors remain explained as ticket traps, not as current clearance rules.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA allows reverse movement only as a necessary low-speed maneuver in specific cases and requires yielding to vehicles entering from parking/garage only when traffic is interrupted.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
Ley 2148 6.1.19 Precauciones al circular marcha atrás
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-031, 043 and 271 without broadening this topic into the future right-of-way pages.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA and Anexo L support red/yellow curb meanings and the prohibition on stopping/parking on or next to ciclovía spaces relevant to assigned curb/cyclist tickets.
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-341 and 396. The red-cordon explanation is generalized; the specific image framing remains tied to the canonical fallback tickets.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L defines horizontal markings as traffic signals on the roadway that regulate, transmit orders, warn, channel circulation, and indicate prohibited zones.
entries.notes: Used for the general demarcación horizontal learning material and b-fallback-415 framing.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L states that continuous lines must not be crossed or driven over, discontinuous lines may be crossed, and parallel continuous/discontinuous lines are read according to the driver's side.
relevantSections: Capítulo VI punto 26.c Trazos continuos y discontinuos
H.1 Línea de separación de sentido de circulación
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-111, b-fallback-170, b-fallback-188, b-fallback-222 and b-fallback-457 without adding any new overtake rule beyond the marking restriction.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA places señales verticales and demarcación horizontal in the same priority tier ahead of general legal rules, and Ley 24.449 requires circulation respecting traffic signs and legal rules in priority order.
entries.notes: Supports the same-meaning/order explanation for b-fallback-415.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA and national law require yielding to pedestrians crossing by pedestrian crossing or designated zones when failing to stop would endanger them; traffic-light rules do not make horn use a substitute for yielding.
entries.notes: Added only because b-fallback-174 is fixed in this topic by current taxonomy; the explanation remains ticket-specific and does not broaden this center-line topic into a full pedestrian-priority lesson.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L supports channelizing markings/islets as no-cross/no-drive-over areas that guide traffic around obstacles, and auxiliary reduction markings as markings that induce speed reduction.
relevantSections: H.7 Líneas auxiliares para reducción de velocidad
H.8 Marcas canalizadoras del tránsito (e isletas)
entries.notes: Supports only generalized channelization/speed-reduction framing. The exact b-fallback-320 answer phrase about reducing turning radius remains ticket-specific because the archived source search did not expose that formula as a general official claim.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA and national law support staying centered in the same lane on multilane roads, advance signaling for lane changes, and warning non-predictable maneuvers without creating risk or affecting traffic flow.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.9 Autopistas y otras vías rápidas
entries.notes: Supports the general maneuver, signaling and lane-positioning material. The specific fallback-ticket priority answer for the vehicle already in the target lane remains ticket-specific rather than broadened into a separately quoted official priority rule.

entries.claimSummaryRu: Anexo L and traffic-law text support exclusive lanes as marked/signaled lanes reserved for determined vehicle types, and ordinary circulation must respect exclusive lanes and their operating rules.
relevantSections: Anexo L H.2 Línea de carril
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-302 and compact exclusive-lane guidance for b-fallback-223. The exact schedule shown in the fallback image is treated as ticket-specific visual context.

entries.claimSummaryRu: CABA and national law support acceleration-lane incorporation without obstructing traffic, deceleration/right-lane positioning for exiting, and first-exit abandonment for vehicles with accident/mechanical trouble or remolque context.
relevantSections: Ley 2148 6.1.7 Obligaciones de los conductores que se incorporen o egresen de la circulación
Ley 2148 6.1.9 Autopistas y otras vías rápidas
entries.notes: Supports b-fallback-336 and b-fallback-358 without adding a broader mechanical-breakdown lesson beyond lane choice and exiting the autopista.
